name: Outside Service History Lookup
summary: Read-only Infor Visual lookup tool for outside service provider dispatch history with part or vendor search, optional in-memory aggregation that combines duplicate vendor-plus-part rows across multiple dispatch dates, fuzzy selection, sortable results, whole-number quantity display, and clear-action refocus back to the part search field.

userActions: Enable vendor-name aggregation only while vendor search mode is active
Aggregate duplicate vendor-name candidates into a smaller selection list
Combine duplicate vendor-plus-part history rows in either search mode
preserveRules: Keep all Infor Visual access read-only
Keep whole-collection result reloads behaviorally equivalent to the prior grid refresh flow
acceptanceCriteria: Part and vendor search modes still return the correct history data
The combine-same-vendor-names checkbox is enabled in vendor mode and disabled in part mode
Vendor aggregation reduces duplicate vendor-name candidates without losing access to combined history
When combine mode is enabled, duplicate vendor-plus-part history rows collapse into one row with Combined Dates and Multiple dispatch markers
The user can confirm fuzzy matches before loading the final result set
The results grid remains sortable and read-only
Clear returns the operator to an immediately ready part-search input
validationHints: Confirm vendor and part modes still hit the intended Infor Visual queries
Confirm the combine-same-vendor-names checkbox re-enables immediately when switching into vendor mode and disables again in part mode
Confirm aggregated vendor-name mode merges duplicate vendor-name candidates and still returns combined part and history results
Confirm both part and vendor search modes combine duplicate vendor-plus-part rows when the checkbox is enabled
Confirm combined rows show Combined Dates, Multiple dispatch IDs, and whole-number quantities
Confirm fuzzy picker flow still occurs when multiple matches are returned
Confirm the results grid still shows dispatch history without enabling edits
Confirm Clear resets vendor-mode searches back to part mode and places keyboard focus in the search box
Confirm search and sort operations still repopulate the results grid correctly after whole-collection replacement
databaseObjects: Infor Visual outside service history queries
